Load configuration files
- location of model drivers, rds files (containing models), tables of parameter estimates and performance metrics, and figures. 
```{r}
read_properties <- function(file_path) {
  lines <- readLines(file_path)
  lines <- lines[grepl("=", lines)]  # only keep lines with key-value pairs
  key_vals <- strsplit(lines, "=")
  props <- setNames(
    trimws(sapply(key_vals, `[`, 2)),
    trimws(sapply(key_vals, `[`, 1))
  )
  return(props)
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# Two input dataframes:
#
#   df      -- Monte Carlo ensemble output (timeseries_by_run_year.csv)
#              columns: run_id | year | submodel | stat_type | value
#              Uncertainty here is the EMPIRICAL spread across the 100
#              Monte Carlo runs -- ci_low/ci_high = 2.5/97.5 percentiles of
#              `value` across run_id, for a given (year, submodel, stat_type).
#              No bootstrap/quantile approximation needed since these are
#              actual repeated realizations.
#
#   df_obs  -- observed truth, gridcell-month resolution
#              (predictions_2002_2011.csv), columns include: lat, lon, year,
#              month, r_strike_obs, n_strikes_obs, fire_count,
#              burned_area_km2_total. Single fixed dataset, no run
#              replication -- aggregated to yearly series via
#              build_observed_timeseries() below for overlay on the ensemble.
# ============================================================================

df <- read.csv(file.path(predictions_root, "parameter_uncertainty/timeseries_by_run_year.csv"))

df_obs <- read.csv(file.path(predictions_root, "predictions_2002_2011.csv"))
```


```{r}


# ---- Summarize the ensemble: mean/median + 95% range across runs ----------
summarize_ensemble <- function(df, submodel_name, stat_type_name, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)) {
  df %>%
    filter(submodel == submodel_name, stat_type == stat_type_name) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(
      estimate = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      median   = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      ci_low   = quantile(value, probs[1], na.rm = TRUE),
      ci_high  = quantile(value, probs[2], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups  = "drop"
    )
}

# ---- Optional: build an observed-side timeseries from df_obs, so it can  ----
# ---- be overlaid on the ensemble plot.                                   ----
# obs_col should be one of: r_strike_obs, n_strikes_obs, fire_count,
# burned_area_km2_total (i.e. the observed counterpart to the submodel).
build_observed_timeseries <- function(obs_df, obs_col, stat_type = c("mean", "sum")) {
  stat_type <- match.arg(stat_type)
  obs_df %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(
      value = if (stat_type == "sum") sum(.data[[obs_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
              else mean(.data[[obs_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# ---- Plot builder: ensemble ribbon + optional observed overlay ------------
plot_ensemble_series <- function(df, submodel_name, stat_type_name, y_label, title,
                                  observed_df = NULL,
                                  pred_color = "red", obs_color = "gold") {

  summary_df <- summarize_ensemble(df, submodel_name, stat_type_name)

  p <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = year, y = estimate)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high), fill = pred_color, alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_line(color = pred_color) +
    geom_point(color = pred_color, size = 3, shape = 7)

  caption_txt <- "Shaded band: 95% range across 100 Monte Carlo runs"

  if (!is.null(observed_df)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_point(data = observed_df, aes(x = year, y = value),
                 color = obs_color, shape = 16, size = 3) +
      geom_line(data = observed_df, aes(x = year, y = value),
                color = obs_color, linetype = "dashed")
    caption_txt <- paste0(caption_txt, " | Points: observed")
  }

  p +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(summary_df$year)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_label, title = title, caption = caption_txt) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8, face = "italic"))
}


# ============================================================================
# Six panels, matching the structure of your original (a)-(f) plots.
# df_obs is the gridcell-month-level dataframe read from
# predictions_2002_2011.csv (single observed truth, no run replication).
# Aggregated to yearly observed series here for overlay on the ensemble.
# ============================================================================

obs_r_strike    <- build_observed_timeseries(df_obs, "r_strike_obs", "mean")
obs_n_strikes   <- build_observed_timeseries(df_obs, "n_strikes_obs", "mean")
obs_n_fires     <- build_observed_timeseries(df_obs, "fire_count", "sum")
obs_burned_mean <- build_observed_timeseries(df_obs, "burned_area_km2_total", "mean")
obs_burned_sum  <- build_observed_timeseries(df_obs, "burned_area_km2_total", "sum")

p1 <- plot_ensemble_series(df, "r_strike", "mean", "Strikes/km2/month", "(a)",
                            observed_df = obs_r_strike)

p2 <- plot_ensemble_series(df, "n_strikes", "mean", "Strike Count", "(b)",
                            observed_df = obs_n_strikes)

p3 <- plot_ensemble_series(df, "p_ignite", "mean", "Ignition Probability", "(c)")
# p_ignite has no direct single-number observed counterpart (it's compared
# against fires/strikes at the gridcell-month level, not a yearly mean) --
# see the ECE/weighted-correlation metrics in metrics_by_iteration.csv
# for the observed-comparison side of this submodel instead.

p4 <- plot_ensemble_series(df, "n_fires", "sum", "Fire Count", "(d)",
                            observed_df = obs_n_fires)

p5 <- plot_ensemble_series(df, "burned_area", "mean", "Mean Burned Area (km2)", "(e)",
                            observed_df = obs_burned_mean)

p6 <- plot_ensemble_series(df, "burned_area", "sum", "Total Burned Area (km2)", "(f)",
                            observed_df = obs_burned_sum)

p1 / p2 / p3 / p4 / p5 / p6

```
